children: Vyas moves into the Deputy CFO role after more than three years with Anupam Rasayan, bringing experience across reporting, tax, governance and cross-border finance

Anupam Rasayan India has appointed Hetvi Vyas as Deputy Chief Financial Officer (Deputy CFO) and Key Managerial Personnel (KMP), marking an internal finance leadership move at the speciality chemicals company. Vyas, who joined Anupam Rasayan in 2023, has experience across financial reporting, consolidation, taxation, governance, risk management and oversight of overseas subsidiaries and acquired entities.
Vyas has progressed within Anupam Rasayan since joining the company as Manager in May 2023. She moved into the role of General Manager in March 2026 before taking on the Deputy CFO and KMP mandate.

Her responsibilities have included finance oversight for international subsidiaries and acquired entities, covering areas such as finance, tax, legal compliance, human resources, ESG and operations. The experience has also involved working with senior leadership and external advisers on financial and governance matters across jurisdictions.
Vyas has worked across financial reporting, consolidation, cross-border tax structuring, governance, risk management and post-acquisition integration.

Her role has included aligning overseas entities with group-level financial processes and governance requirements, alongside supporting operational integration following acquisitions. The work gives her exposure to finance responsibilities extending beyond accounting into compliance, risk and business integration. She has also partnered with senior leadership and global advisers to align international entities with group standards while supporting governance and strategic priorities.
Before joining Anupam Rasayan, Vyas worked as a Chartered Accountant with Natvarlal Vepari & Co from May 2017 to April 2023.

During that period, she developed experience in Accounting Standards, Indian Accounting Standards and International Financial Reporting Standards. Earlier in her career, she completed her professional training with DSI & Co in Surat.
The combination of technical accounting and corporate finance experience has formed the basis of her progression into broader leadership responsibilities.

As Deputy CFO and KMP, Vyas takes on a wider role within Anupam Rasayan’s finance and governance structure. Her background spans reporting, tax, controls, risk management and international entity oversight.

The appointment also reflects an internal progression after more than three years with the company, moving from managerial roles into a senior finance leadership position with responsibilities across domestic and overseas operations.
